text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much for the birthday 
wishes~. And for the gift, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah—, press-on nails... was that it? I 
wonder if they're different from what 
Espo-san paints on?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rather than applying polish directly 
to the nails, these are press-on nails 
applied with special double-sided tape.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
According to Espo-san, they're gentle on 
your nails and easy to remove.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wha...?! I-I didn't say that!! I 
definitely didn't say that, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...What is it, huh?! If you don't like 
it, just shove it right back at me, damn 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no. You remembered our chat about 
how Espo-san's nails were so cute and 
nice... Fufu~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat!? NO WAYYYY!! That was just a 
total coincidence!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much too, Furioso-san~ It 
has turned out to be a wonderful birthday.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"! ...Acute-san and I are rivals. Strictly 
speaking, we shouldn't be socializing like 
this. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I'm indebted to them daily. 
For the pride of Funabashi, I must return 
the favor.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. To be celebrated by such kind 
folks, I sure am one lucky gal~.
